item.name: API-EXT-04 | Anonymous session has no address

request.description: successful-read. Expected status: [200]

exec: pm.test('Latency within configured limit', () => { pm.expect(Number.isFinite(limit) && limit > 0).to.eql(true); pm.expect(pm.response.responseTime).to.be.at.most(limit); });
pm.test('Anonymous session', () => { const data = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(data).to.be.an('object'); pm.expect(data.address == null).to.eql(true); });
